name: Gated HTA Archive Loader with Pseudo-PNG Local Staging and Signed Network Stack
description: A targeted delivery and payload-composition pattern where a lure references gated HTA delivery infrastructure, the HTA stage retrieves a shared ZIP archive, the archive contains a legitimate application plus a side-loaded loader chain, local encoded blobs reconstruct a pseudo-PNG IDAT container, the decoded payload bundle deploys signed utility components, and the final network surface may use LAN-local discovery or an internal controller rather than a static external C2.

shape.x_role_hint: Gated HTA or scriptable entry stage
Legitimate host application used as local execution cover
Encoded local blob or decoded intermediate stage
Pseudo-file-format container such as pseudo-PNG IDAT staging
Signed host and third-party network-capable component
Internal peer or controller inferred from protocol design

x_notes: Pattern abstracts concrete file names away and keeps the stable structure: gated HTA delivery, shared archive retrieval, legitimate host plus side-loaded loader, local encoded blob chain, pseudo-PNG staged container, decoded payload bundle, and signed network-capable tooling.

The pseudo-PNG IDAT stage is modeled structurally under composition because it behaves like a local staged container. IIM-T025 is close but not perfect, so the position also carries x_candidate_technique.

The signed PassMark / VSLauncher network surface is not forced into IIM-T018 because it is not classic third-party application API C2. It is kept as an extension candidate for signed third-party network stack reuse.

The final C2 positions are optional because the analyzed artifacts did not contain a static external C2. LAN-local discovery and an internal peer/controller are modeled as tentative structural positions.
Useful matching signal: the structure survives rotation better than the HTA names, archive name, file hashes, or delivery IP.
